a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost certainly leaves us both with 0 cells. The reserve holds only 4, so only one of us can be safe in round 1. I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than quietly break our agreement. If you also take, the split is random. If we both end up below 4, I'll operate with you afterward. If you see a fairer option, tell me.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. Our messages crossed, so I know you planned to operate. I'm sorry this breaks our plan. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.
